classification: Authored proposed translation of the full reported route; review-only and not executable

routes.name: Verify source, rights and duplicates
routes.required_output: Source identity/version, hold-list audit and deduplication receipts
routes.rule: Reject any held source or duplicated paper; preserve restricted rights

routes.name: Receive and identify target families
routes.required_output: Four target-family receipts plus explicitly optional uncoated comparator
routes.rule: Composition ambiguity quarantines the star branch; other independent branches remain recorded

routes.name: Obtain finished specimens from qualified services
routes.required_output: Final dimensions, surface state, fabrication provenance and protected carriers
routes.rule: Route represents every reported preparation family without exposing hazardous operations

routes.name: Obtain reference characterization and baseline-state frame map
routes.required_output: Calibrated reference data, pre-alteration baseline-state record and specimen/ROI linkage
routes.rule: Source acquisition order is unknown; service plan must preserve history and avoid damage

routes.name: Qualify sphere stocks and lens controls
routes.required_output: Sphere lot records; separate 0.5/2.5 mm SIL IDs; objective compatibility receipts
routes.rule: Keep 1,3,4.74,10,50 um conditions distinct; star sphere size remains unreported

routes.name: Prepare documented coating or lens-contact states
routes.required_output: Child-state receipts for each preparation/contact condition
routes.rule: Retain pre-alteration baseline state and its reference record. Bare optical controls require an uncoated branch or explicitly documented matched specimen; no assumption a coated coupon can be restored identically.

routes.name: Acquire transmission target observations
routes.required_output: E01 and E02 optical records with independent focus and calibration
routes.rule: Targets and output examples are source-grounded; acquisition commands remain unqualified

routes.name: Acquire reflection target observations
routes.required_output: E03 and E04 records, mode/target state and composition qualifications
routes.rule: Do not insert 4.74 um for the star panel without a new qualified specimen receipt

routes.name: Retain bare and SIL comparator branches
routes.required_output: CTRL01/02 records with objective/focus differences and explicit SIL-contact state receipts; bare records must link to a preserved uncoated state or documented matched specimen
routes.rule: A source control failure is a result; it is not an instruction to force a success

routes.name: Represent size, coating, array and extension claims
routes.required_output: C02/C03/C04/E05 claim ledger with explicit text-only, proposed or unrun state
routes.rule: No synthetic completion for unseen data; no invented full Cartesian experiment matrix

routes.name: Compare optical and reference evidence
routes.required_output: Units, transforms, metric/uncertainty and limitation report
routes.rule: No hard-coded source outcome as task success; no independent 50 nm certification here

routes.name: Review theoretical branches without execution
routes.required_output: N01-N04 source-method inventory and explicit unrun receipts
routes.rule: Keep measured, heuristic, analytic and numerical results separate

routes.name: Close out and archive all outcomes
routes.required_output: Specimen disposition, service release, raw/derived record hashes and final branch ledger
routes.rule: Quarantined branches remain visible; do not count an unresolved route as complete

scope_limit: A future implementation must include preparation, identities, dependencies, comparisons, failures and closeout, rather than just move finished coupons between instruments.
all_service_commands: Absent by design; qualified service receipts are prerequisites, not generated substitutes for actual work.
